causal_interpretation.publishTime: Only numeric plausible-millisecond publishTime may establish causal announcement timing.
causal_interpretation.dateTimestamp: Diagnostic/source metadata only. Never substituted for publishTime.
causal_interpretation.legacy_rows_without_publishTime: Allowed to exist in the historical endpoint response. They do not fail the census merely by being retrieved.
causal_interpretation.exact_in_scope_match_without_publishTime: Fail-closed REVIEW because causal publication time cannot be established.
causal_interpretation.pre_launch_same_symbol_notice: Excluded from the current listing episode when numeric publishTime is earlier than instrument launchTime.
causal_interpretation.post_delivery_notice: Retained only as a diagnostic count and never used as causal notice.

resilience_changes: normalize missing/invalid publishTime without aborting on unrelated historical rows
require exact-symbol relevance before missing publishTime becomes an integrity issue
do not use dateTimestamp as a causal fallback
use launchTime as a causal lower bound when available
paginate safely even if total is absent
do not retry deterministic JSON/schema/retCode errors
persist a source-only REVIEW report on live exceptions
